blocks.zh: 人員訓練 • 物料與封閉件 • 內毒素控制 • 時間限制
blocks.en: Personnel Training • Components and Closures • Endotoxin Control • Time Limits

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives — 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Explain the personnel training framework and gowning qualification program for aseptic manufacturing. / 說明無菌製造的人員訓練框架與著裝資格鑑定計畫。
blocks.en: Explain the personnel training framework and gowning qualification program for aseptic manufacturing.

blocks.zh: Describe sterilization and depyrogenation methods for components, glass, plastic, and rubber closures. / 描述原料成分、玻璃、塑膠容器及橡膠封閉件的滅菌與去熱原方法。
blocks.en: Describe sterilization and depyrogenation methods for components, glass, plastic, and rubber closures.

blocks.zh: Understand the 3-log (99.9%) endotoxin reduction validation requirement. / 理解 3 log（99.9%）內毒素削減的驗證要求。
blocks.en: Understand the 3-log (99.9%) endotoxin reduction validation requirement.

blocks.zh: Identify all key endotoxin control points across the manufacturing process including equipment. / 辨識製程各環節（含設備）的關鍵內毒素控制點。
blocks.en: Identify all key endotoxin control points across the manufacturing process including equipment.

blocks.zh: Establish the scientific rationale for time limits in each phase of aseptic processing. / 建立無菌製程各階段時間限制的科學依據。
blocks.en: Establish the scientific rationale for time limits in each phase of aseptic processing.

blocks.zh: Connect regulatory requirements to CDMO audit readiness and batch disposition decisions. / 將法規要求連結至 CDMO 稽查整備與批次放行決策。
blocks.en: Connect regulatory requirements to CDMO audit readiness and batch disposition decisions.

blocks.zh: Section V.A — Personnel Training & Aseptic Technique | 人員訓練與無菌操作技術
blocks.en: Section V.A — Personnel Training & Aseptic Technique

blocks.zh: V.A 人員訓練與無菌技術（中文解說）
blocks.en: V.A Personnel Training and Aseptic Technique (Commentary)

blocks.zh: 這一節的核心訊息：人是無菌製程中最大的污染風險源。每位操作員每天脫落數百萬片皮屑；每次說話、每次快速移動，都可能破壞精心設計的單向氣流保護。FDA 的回應是：用訓練、規範與持續監管來控制這個風險。
blocks.en: The core message of this section: people are the greatest source of contamination risk in aseptic processing. Every operator sheds millions of skin particles each day, and every word spoken or fast movement made can disrupt a carefully designed unidirectional airflow. FDA's answer is to control this risk through training, discipline, and ongoing oversight.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：訓練的三個層次
blocks.en: Core concept: three layers of training

blocks.zh: 入職前訓練（Initial Training）：七大必修主題，缺一不可，且必須在進入無菌區之前完成。
blocks.en: Initial training: seven mandatory topics, none optional, completed before the operator enters the aseptic area.

blocks.zh: 持續訓練（Ongoing Training）：FDA 要求頻率「足夠」（sufficient frequency），不能僅訓練一次就結束。
blocks.en: Ongoing training: FDA expects a "sufficient" frequency; training cannot be a one-time event.

blocks.zh: 主管評核（Supervisory Evaluation）：主管須定期在現場觀察操作員的合規情形；QC 單位提供常規監管。
blocks.en: Supervisory evaluation: supervisors must periodically observe operators' compliance on the floor, and the QC unit provides routine oversight.

blocks.zh: 三個層次缺一不可。任何一層失效，都可能在 FDA 查廠時形成 483 觀察項目。
blocks.en: All three layers are essential. Failure of any one of them can become a Form 483 observation during an FDA inspection.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：無菌操作員 = 外科醫師上手術台
blocks.en: Real-life analogy: an aseptic operator is like a surgeon going into the operating room

blocks.zh: 外科醫師在進行心臟手術前，每一個動作都有規範——如何刷手、如何讓護士協助戴上手套而不碰觸外表面、進入手術室後手臂必須保持在腰部以上……。無菌製造操作員的每一個動作，要求的嚴謹程度完全相同：「移動要緩慢而有目的性」、「不要站在氣流路徑上」、「靠近關鍵區時不能說話」——這些都是從手術室借鑒來的規範，因為保護病患的邏輯是一樣的。
blocks.en: Before heart surgery, every surgeon's movement is governed by rules: how to scrub, how a nurse helps put on gloves without touching the outer surface, keeping the arms above waist level once in the operating room, and so on. An aseptic manufacturing operator is held to exactly the same level of rigor: "move slowly and deliberately," "do not stand in the airflow path," "do not speak near the critical area." These practices are borrowed from the operating room because the logic of protecting the patient is the same.

blocks.zh: CDMO 稽查重點：訓練記錄常見缺失
blocks.en: CDMO audit focus: common training record deficiencies

blocks.zh: 訓練記錄缺少日期、簽名或講師資訊
blocks.en: Training records missing the date, signature, or trainer information

blocks.zh: 無法證明訓練「持續進行」（缺乏再訓練紀錄）
blocks.en: Inability to show that training is "ongoing" (no retraining records)

blocks.zh: 操作員執行了未受過訓練的工作
blocks.en: Operators performing tasks they have not been trained for

blocks.zh: 主管現場評核記錄不存在或流於形式
blocks.en: Supervisory on-the-floor evaluation records are missing or only perfunctory

blocks.zh: 客戶在技術協議（Technical Agreement）審查時，通常也會確認訓練體系的完整性。
blocks.en: Clients also typically confirm the completeness of the training system when they review the Technical Agreement.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 — 人員訓練
blocks.en: Thought Exercise — Personnel Training

blocks.zh: 一位操作員在充填線旁與同事討論問題，距關鍵區約 30 公分。這是否符合 FDA 要求？為什麼？
blocks.en: An operator is discussing a problem with a colleague beside the filling line, about 30 cm from the critical area. Does this meet FDA expectations? Why or why not?

blocks.zh: FDA 要求「持續訓練」，你認為公司應如何設計年度訓練計畫才能滿足此要求？
blocks.en: FDA requires "ongoing training." How should a company design its annual training plan to meet this requirement?

blocks.zh: 如果 QC 主管的現場評核記錄每年只有一次，FDA 可能提出哪些質疑？
blocks.en: If a QC supervisor's on-the-floor evaluation records show only one evaluation per year, what questions might FDA raise?

blocks.zh: Section V.A — Gowning Qualification Program | 著裝資格鑑定計畫
blocks.en: Section V.A — Gowning Qualification Program

blocks.zh: V.A 著裝資格鑑定計畫（中文解說）
blocks.en: V.A Gowning Qualification Program (Commentary)

blocks.zh: 著裝（Gowning）不只是「穿上無菌衣服」。它是一道需要數據支撐的屏障系統（Barrier System），且每位操作員必須個別通過資格鑑定，才能進入無菌製造區域。
blocks.en: Gowning is more than "putting on sterile garments." It is a barrier system that must be supported by data, and each operator must individually pass qualification before entering the aseptic manufacturing area.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：著裝資格鑑定的三個關鍵要素
blocks.en: Core concept: three key elements of gowning qualification

blocks.zh: 取樣位置標準化：FDA 建議對手指、口罩、前臂、胸部進行微生物表面取樣——這些是最容易累積微生物的部位。
blocks.en: Standardized sampling locations: FDA recommends microbiological surface sampling of the fingers, face mask, forearms, and chest, which are the sites where microorganisms most easily accumulate.

blocks.zh: 定期再鑑定（Requalification）：通過一次不夠，需要定期重做。若發生不良事件（如微生物超標），必須增加頻率。
blocks.en: Periodic requalification: passing once is not enough; qualification must be repeated periodically. If an adverse event occurs (such as a microbial excursion), the frequency must be increased.

blocks.zh: 取樣前不得消毒手套：FDA 特別指出這是不當行為——取樣前消毒手套，會把操作過程中真實存在的微生物殺死，導致結果失真，掩蓋真正的風險。
blocks.en: No disinfection of gloves before sampling: FDA specifically identifies this as an improper practice. Disinfecting gloves before sampling kills the microorganisms actually picked up during operations, which distorts the results and masks the true risk.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：著裝程序 = 外科醫師穿手術服的程序
blocks.en: Real-life analogy: the gowning procedure is like a surgeon putting on surgical attire

blocks.zh: 外科醫師穿手術袍有嚴格順序——由護士協助繫帶（自己不能碰外表面），最後由護士協助戴上無菌手套（確保手套外面未被污染）。無菌室著裝的邏輯完全相同：SOP 規定的「套疊順序」（例如手套要蓋過袖口）確保沒有皮膚裸露在外。如果任何一個步驟走錯，屏障效果就可能失效——就像外科醫師不小心碰到手術台外側，手套就必須立即更換一樣。
blocks.en: A surgeon puts on a surgical gown in a strict sequence: a nurse ties the gown (the surgeon cannot touch the outer surface), and finally a nurse helps put on the sterile gloves (so the outside of the gloves is not contaminated). The logic of aseptic gowning is exactly the same: the "layering order" in the SOP (for example, gloves over the cuffs) ensures no skin is exposed. If any step goes wrong, the barrier can fail, just as a surgeon who accidentally touches the outside of the surgical table must change gloves immediately.

blocks.zh: CDMO 483 高風險項目：著裝資格鑑定常見缺失
blocks.en: CDMO Form 483 high-risk items: common gowning qualification deficiencies

blocks.zh: 無書面 SOP 規定著裝順序與取樣計畫
blocks.en: No written SOP defining the gowning sequence and the sampling plan

blocks.zh: 超標後未進行調查與再鑑定
blocks.en: No investigation or requalification after an excursion

blocks.zh: 取樣前消毒手套（影響數據真實性）
blocks.en: Disinfecting gloves before sampling (compromises data integrity)

blocks.zh: 著裝鑑定記錄不完整或未與批次生產掛鉤
blocks.en: Gowning qualification records that are incomplete or not linked to batch production

blocks.zh: 臨時人員（合約工）未完成鑑定即進入無菌區
blocks.en: Temporary staff (contract workers) entering the aseptic area without completing qualification

blocks.zh: 著裝鑑定不合格的操作員若曾進入客戶產品的充填間，可能觸發批次拒絕與客戶通知義務。
blocks.en: If an operator who failed gowning qualification has entered the filling room for a client's product, this may trigger batch rejection and a customer notification obligation.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 — 著裝資格鑑定
blocks.en: Thought Exercise — Gowning Qualification

blocks.zh: 一位操作員在著裝資格取樣前剛消毒了雙手手套，結果顯示零菌落。這個結果可以被接受嗎？FDA 會如何看待？
blocks.en: An operator disinfects both gloved hands just before gowning qualification sampling, and the result shows zero colonies. Can this result be accepted? How would FDA view it?

blocks.zh: 某操作員 1 月通過著裝鑑定，但 6 月的環境監測顯示其著裝表面出現超標。依 FDA 建議，公司應採取哪些步驟？
blocks.en: An operator passed gowning qualification in January, but environmental monitoring in June shows an excursion on the gowning surfaces. Based on FDA's recommendations, what steps should the company take?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 SOP 中必須明確規定「重訓、再鑑定、或重新分配」的觸發條件？
blocks.en: Why must the SOP clearly define the triggers for "retraining, requalification, or reassignment"?

blocks.zh: Section V.B & V.C — Laboratory Personnel & Monitoring Program | 實驗室人員與監測計畫
blocks.en: Section V.B & V.C — Laboratory Personnel & Monitoring Program

blocks.zh: V.B & V.C 實驗室人員與人員監測計畫（中文解說）
blocks.en: V.B & V.C Laboratory Personnel and Personnel Monitoring Program (Commentary)

blocks.zh: 人員監測計畫是無菌製程的「免疫系統」——它的功能不是懲罰人，而是早期偵測趨勢，在問題演變為批次失敗之前介入。
blocks.en: The personnel monitoring program is the "immune system" of aseptic processing. Its purpose is not to punish people but to detect trends early and intervene before a problem becomes a batch failure.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：監測計畫的兩個維度
blocks.en: Core concept: two dimensions of the monitoring program

blocks.zh: 常規監測：每位操作員每天或每批次一次手套表面取樣，加上部分著裝表面取樣。建立個人基線數據。
blocks.en: Routine monitoring: glove surface sampling for each operator every day or every batch, plus sampling of some gown surfaces, to build an individual baseline.

blocks.zh: 加強監測觸發：超出警戒限（Alert Level）或行動限（Action Level）時，必須啟動調查、增加取樣、觀察、再訓練、再鑑定，必要時重新分配崗位。
blocks.en: Enhanced monitoring triggers: when an alert level or action level is exceeded, an investigation, additional sampling, observation, retraining, and requalification must be initiated, with reassignment of duties if necessary.

blocks.zh: V.B 提醒：實驗室人員（執行無菌取樣、微生物分析）同樣適用這些要求。若實驗室數據的有效性受到質疑，整個品質系統的可信度都會崩潰。
blocks.en: V.B reminder: laboratory personnel (who perform aseptic sampling and microbiological analysis) are subject to the same requirements. If the validity of laboratory data is questioned, the credibility of the entire quality system collapses.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：監測計畫 = 飛行員定期體檢
blocks.en: Real-life analogy: the monitoring program is like regular medical checkups for airline pilots

blocks.zh: 民航飛行員必須定期接受體檢；若健康狀況不符標準，必須暫停飛行直到恢復。這不是不信任飛行員，而是因為乘客安全需要系統性保障，不能依賴個人自我評估。無菌室操作員的每日手套取樣邏輯相同——建立一套客觀的、數據驅動的持續監控機制，確保任何問題都能及早被發現。
blocks.en: Commercial pilots must undergo regular medical examinations, and if their health falls short of the standard, they must stop flying until they recover. This is not distrust of pilots; passenger safety requires a systematic safeguard rather than reliance on self-assessment. The logic behind daily glove sampling of cleanroom operators is the same: build an objective, data-driven, continuous monitoring mechanism so that any problem is found early.

blocks.zh: 實務警示：趨勢分析比單點超標更重要
blocks.en: Practical warning: trend analysis matters more than a single excursion

blocks.zh: FDA 不只看單次超標，更關注趨勢（Trend）。若某操作員連續 5 次菌落數接近警戒限但未超行動限，部分公司可能不採取行動——但這在 FDA 眼中是「不良趨勢未被識別與回應」的缺失。健全的監測計畫必須在 SOP 中定義「不良趨勢」的判定標準與回應程序。
blocks.en: FDA looks not only at single excursions but also at trends. If an operator's colony counts come close to the alert level five times in a row without exceeding the action level, some companies may take no action, but in FDA's eyes this is a deficiency: "an adverse trend was not identified and responded to." A sound monitoring program must define in the SOP the criteria for an "adverse trend" and the response procedure.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 — 人員監測
blocks.en: Thought Exercise — Personnel Monitoring

blocks.zh: 實驗室人員執行無菌取樣時，是否需要與生產操作員相同的著裝資格鑑定？為什麼？
blocks.en: Do laboratory personnel who perform aseptic sampling need the same gowning qualification as production operators? Why?

blocks.zh: 某操作員連續三週手套取樣結果為 1 CFU（警戒限 3 CFU，行動限 5 CFU）。公司應採取什麼行動？
blocks.en: An operator's glove sampling results are 1 CFU for three consecutive weeks (alert limit 3 CFU, action limit 5 CFU). What action should the company take?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「取樣前不得消毒手套」這個要求，從數據完整性（Data Integrity）角度特別重要？
blocks.en: Why is the requirement of "no glove disinfection before sampling" especially important from a data integrity perspective?

blocks.zh: Section VI.A — Components | 原料成分管控
blocks.en: Section VI.A — Components

blocks.zh: VI.A 原料成分管控（中文解說）
blocks.en: VI.A Component Control (Commentary)

blocks.zh: 無菌藥品的污染路徑不只來自人員和環境——原料本身就可能是污染的起點。即使後續滅菌做得再好，若投入物料的內毒素負荷過高，最終產品仍可能造成病患發燒或敗血性休克。
blocks.en: Contamination pathways in sterile drug products come not only from personnel and the environment: the components themselves can be the starting point of contamination. However well the later sterilization is carried out, if the input materials carry a high endotoxin load, the final product can still cause fever or septic shock in patients.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：物料管控的兩個關鍵指標
blocks.en: Core concept: two key indicators for material control

blocks.zh: 生物負荷（Bioburden）：物料中存活的微生物數量。對滅菌製程設計至關重要——滅菌前生物負荷愈高，需要更強的滅菌條件才能保證無菌保證水準（SAL）。
blocks.en: Bioburden: the number of viable microorganisms in the material. It is critical to sterilization process design: the higher the pre-sterilization bioburden, the more rigorous the sterilization conditions needed to ensure the sterility assurance level (SAL).

blocks.zh: 內毒素（Endotoxin）：革蘭氏陰性菌細胞壁的脂多醣（LPS）片段。即使細菌已被殺死，內毒素仍存在且具有高熱原活性，注射到人體後引起發熱，嚴重時致命。
blocks.en: Endotoxin: lipopolysaccharide (LPS) fragments from the cell wall of Gram-negative bacteria. Even after the bacteria are killed, endotoxin remains and is highly pyrogenic; when injected into the body it causes fever and, in severe cases, can be fatal.

blocks.zh: 每批物料都必須有明確的生物負荷與內毒素接受標準；不符標準的批次必須拒絕（Reject）——不可妥協。
blocks.en: Every batch of material must have clear acceptance criteria for bioburden and endotoxin; a batch that does not meet them must be rejected, with no compromise.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：內毒素 = 外觀完好但已含毒素的食物
blocks.en: Real-life analogy: endotoxin is like food that looks fine but already contains toxins

blocks.zh: 想像一鍋煮熟的白米飯放在室溫 12 小時。外觀、氣味看起來都好，但蠟樣芽孢桿菌已在冷卻過程中大量繁殖，並產生了耐熱毒素。就算之後重新加熱到 100°C 殺死細菌，那些毒素依然存在，吃了還是會食物中毒。內毒素的道理完全相同：普通加熱滅菌可以殺死細菌，但殺死細菌不等於去除內毒素。這就是為什麼注射劑對每批原料都需要獨立的內毒素檢驗，而不能只依賴滅菌製程。
blocks.en: Imagine a pot of cooked white rice left at room temperature for 12 hours. It looks and smells fine, but Bacillus cereus has multiplied heavily while it cooled and produced heat-stable toxins. Even if you reheat it to 100°C and kill the bacteria, the toxins remain, and eating it still causes food poisoning. Endotoxin works the same way: ordinary heat sterilization can kill bacteria, but killing bacteria is not the same as removing endotoxin. This is why injectable products require independent endotoxin testing of every batch of materials rather than relying on the sterilization process alone.

blocks.zh: CDMO 業務風險：物料內毒素 OOS 的連鎖後果
blocks.en: CDMO business risk: the chain of consequences of a material endotoxin OOS

blocks.zh: 整批製品可能需要拒絕（即使已完成後續所有製程）
blocks.en: The entire batch of product may have to be rejected (even if all subsequent processing steps have been completed)

blocks.zh: 必須向客戶通知（Customer Notification），影響交期與信任關係
blocks.en: Customer notification is required, affecting delivery schedules and the trust relationship

blocks.zh: 若已放行，可能觸發市場召回（Recall）
blocks.en: If the batch has already been released, it may trigger a market recall

blocks.zh: 必須進行根本原因分析（RCA）並提交 CAPA
blocks.en: Root cause analysis (RCA) must be performed and a CAPA submitted

blocks.zh: 紮實的進料管控（Incoming Material Testing）與供應商資格審核（Supplier Qualification）是避免這些代價高昂場景的第一道防線。
blocks.en: Robust incoming material testing and supplier qualification are the first line of defense against these costly scenarios.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 — 原料成分管控
blocks.en: Thought Exercise — Component Control

blocks.zh: 為什麼熱不穩定性（heat-labile）的 API 不能使用高壓蒸汽滅菌，而必須考慮過濾滅菌？
blocks.en: Why can a heat-labile API not be sterilized by autoclaving, and why must filter sterilization be considered instead?

blocks.zh: 某粉末狀原料採用乾熱滅菌。為什麼 FDA 特別強調粉末的熱穿透研究（Heat Penetration Study）？
blocks.en: A powder component is sterilized by dry heat. Why does FDA place particular emphasis on a heat penetration study for powders?

blocks.zh: 若某批 WFI 的內毒素檢測結果為 0.06 EU/mL（接受標準 0.05 EU/mL），公司應如何處理？
blocks.en: If a batch of WFI gives an endotoxin result of 0.06 EU/mL (acceptance criterion 0.05 EU/mL), how should the company handle it?

blocks.zh: Section VI.B — Containers & Closures Preparation | 容器與封閉件之製備
blocks.en: Section VI.B — Containers & Closures Preparation

blocks.zh: VI.B 容器與封閉件製備（中文解說）
blocks.en: VI.B Container and Closure Preparation (Commentary)

blocks.zh: 容器和封閉件必須同時達到無菌且不含熱原（Sterile & Nonpyrogenic）兩個標準，缺一不可，且兩者都需要驗證數據支撐。
blocks.en: Containers and closures must meet both standards: sterile and nonpyrogenic. Neither can be omitted, and both require validation data as support.

blocks.zh: 3-Log 去熱原驗證：1000 倍的毒素削減
blocks.en: 3-log depyrogenation validation: a 1000-fold reduction in endotoxin

blocks.zh: FDA 要求玻璃容器去熱原驗證至少達到 3 log（99.9%）的內毒素削減。
blocks.en: FDA requires depyrogenation validation of glass containers to achieve at least a 3-log (99.9%) reduction in endotoxin.

blocks.zh: 具體計算：若驗證時在玻璃瓶內壁接種 1,000 EU 的內毒素標準品，乾熱處理後殘留必須不超過 1 EU。
blocks.en: Specific calculation: if 1,000 EU of endotoxin standard is inoculated onto the inner wall of a glass vial during validation, the residual after dry heat treatment must not exceed 1 EU.

blocks.zh: 1,000 EU → 不超過 1 EU = 削減 99.9% = 3 log 削減。
blocks.en: 1,000 EU → no more than 1 EU = 99.9% reduction = 3-log reduction.

blocks.zh: 陽性對照（Positive Control）確認回收率，確保 LAL 測定方法本身有效。這個要求是最低標準（Minimum Requirement），不是建議。
blocks.en: A positive control confirms recovery and ensures that the LAL assay itself is valid. This is a minimum requirement, not a recommendation.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：3-Log 削減 = 讓毒素減少 1000 倍
blocks.en: Real-life analogy: a 3-log reduction means cutting the toxin 1000-fold

blocks.zh: 把 3 log 換算成日常語言：如果起始有 1,000 單位的內毒素，完成去熱原後只能剩下不到 1 單位——這相當於把一個足球場大小的空間，壓縮到一張 A4 紙的面積。這樣的削減倍率才能確保注射劑進入人體後不會引發熱原反應。在客戶審計和監管說明中，「1000 倍削減」是最直觀的解釋方式。
blocks.en: In everyday terms: if you start with 1,000 units of endotoxin, only less than 1 unit may remain after depyrogenation. That is like compressing the space of a football field down to the area of a sheet of A4 paper. Only a reduction of this magnitude ensures that an injectable product will not cause a pyrogenic reaction once it enters the body. In customer audits and regulatory explanations, "1000-fold reduction" is the most intuitive way to explain it.

blocks.zh: CDMO 稽查要點：委外滅菌設施管理
blocks.en: CDMO audit points: managing outsourced sterilization facilities

blocks.zh: 若將容器封閉件的滅菌/去熱原委外，FDA 要求：
blocks.en: If sterilization/depyrogenation of containers and closures is outsourced, FDA expects that:

blocks.zh: 藥品製造商必須審查並評估委外廠的驗證協議（Validation Protocol）和最終驗證報告（Final Validation Report）
blocks.en: The drug manufacturer must review and evaluate the contractor's validation protocol and final validation report

blocks.zh: 委外廠同樣受 CGMP 規範，不因委外而降低要求
blocks.en: The contractor is also subject to CGMP; outsourcing does not lower the requirements

blocks.zh: 品質協議（Quality Agreement）必須明確責任歸屬
blocks.en: The Quality Agreement must clearly assign responsibilities

blocks.zh: 客戶稽查時通常會要求查閱容器封閉件供應商的去熱原驗證報告，以及公司對這些報告的審查記錄。
blocks.en: In a client audit, auditors will usually ask to see the depyrogenation validation reports from the container closure supplier and the company's records of its review of those reports.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 — 容器與封閉件
blocks.en: Thought Exercise — Containers and Closures

blocks.zh: 為什麼橡膠瓶塞不能像玻璃容器一樣使用乾熱烘箱滅菌，而必須選用蒸汽或輻射？
blocks.en: Why can rubber stoppers not be sterilized in a dry heat oven like glass containers, and why must steam or irradiation be used instead?

blocks.zh: EtO 滅菌後，為什麼必須進行通風散氣（Degassing/Aeration）步驟並監測 EtO 殘留量？
blocks.en: After EtO sterilization, why must a degassing/aeration step be performed and EtO residuals monitored?

blocks.zh: 橡膠瓶塞洗滌後，FDA 為什麼強調「最小化洗滌、乾燥、滅菌之間的時間間隔」？
blocks.en: After rubber stoppers are washed, why does FDA emphasize "minimizing the time between washing, drying, and sterilization"?

blocks.zh: 某公司將橡膠瓶塞滅菌委外。FDA 要求藥品製造商必須做什麼？
blocks.en: A company outsources sterilization of its rubber stoppers. What does FDA require the drug manufacturer to do?

blocks.zh: Section VI.B — Container Closure Integrity | 容器密封完整性
blocks.en: Section VI.B — Container Closure Integrity

blocks.zh: VI.B 容器密封完整性（中文解說）
blocks.en: VI.B Container Closure Integrity (Commentary)

blocks.zh: 容器密封系統是藥品無菌性的最後一道實體屏障。即使藥品在充填時完美無菌，若密封出現微孔或缺陷，外部微生物依然可能隨時間滲入。
blocks.en: The container closure system is the last physical barrier to the sterility of a drug product. Even if the product was perfectly sterile at filling, if the seal has a pinhole or defect, external microorganisms can still enter over time.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：CCI 的兩個保護面向
blocks.en: Core concept: two protective functions of CCI

blocks.zh: 阻擋微生物入侵：密封必須在整個貨架期內阻止微生物穿透，這是最核心的功能。
blocks.en: Blocking microbial ingress: the seal must prevent microbial penetration throughout the shelf life. This is the most fundamental function.

blocks.zh: 傳遞裝置功能性：預充填注射器等含傳遞裝置的產品，還需監控容量準確性、活塞滑動力等功能性指標。
blocks.en: Delivery device functionality: products that include a delivery device, such as prefilled syringes, also require monitoring of functional attributes such as dose accuracy and plunger break-loose and glide force.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：CCI = 真空保鮮袋的密封性
blocks.en: Real-life analogy: CCI is like the seal of a vacuum food storage bag

blocks.zh: 真空保鮮袋的目的是隔絕空氣和微生物。但如果袋子有肉眼看不到的微孔，它外觀仍像「密封的」，食物卻已在你不知情的情況下慢慢變質。藥品容器密封失效的邏輯完全相同——這就是為什麼 CCI 驗證必須使用靈敏的儀器方法（如染料滲透、真空衰減、高壓放電），而不能僅憑視覺檢查。
blocks.en: The purpose of a vacuum bag is to keep out air and microorganisms. But if the bag has pinholes invisible to the naked eye, it still looks "sealed" while the food spoils without your knowing. The logic of drug container closure failure is exactly the same, which is why CCI validation must use sensitive instrumental methods (such as dye ingress, vacuum decay, or high-voltage leak detection) and cannot rely on visual inspection alone.

blocks.zh: CDMO 品質風險：CCI 失效的連鎖反應
blocks.en: CDMO quality risk: the chain reaction of a CCI failure

blocks.zh: 若在市場上發現：可能觸發第一類召回（Class I Recall）
blocks.en: If found on the market: may trigger a Class I recall

blocks.zh: 若在廠內發現：整批產品面臨銷毀風險
blocks.en: If found in-house: the whole batch is at risk of destruction

blocks.zh: 客戶必須被通知，影響後續合約
blocks.en: The customer must be notified, affecting future contracts

blocks.zh: FDA 要求根本原因調查與 CAPA，可能要求重新驗證充填封蓋設備
blocks.en: FDA requires root cause investigation and CAPA, and may require revalidation of the filling and capping equipment

blocks.zh: 思考練習 — 容器密封完整性
blocks.en: Thought Exercise — Container Closure Integrity

blocks.zh: 為什麼視覺檢查（Visual Inspection）對於判定 CCI 是不夠的？還需要什麼樣的驗證？
blocks.en: Why is visual inspection not sufficient to determine CCI? What other validation is needed?

blocks.zh: 若批次最終放行前的檢驗中發現 0.2% 的玻璃瓶有密封異常，公司應如何依 21 CFR 211.192 進行調查？
blocks.en: If testing before final batch release finds that 0.2% of the glass vials have seal abnormalities, how should the company investigate under 21 CFR 211.192?

blocks.zh: 預充填注射器（Pre-filled Syringe）的 CCI 測試，除了防止微生物入侵外，還需要監控哪些功能性指標？
blocks.en: For CCI testing of a prefilled syringe, besides preventing microbial ingress, what functional attributes also need to be monitored?

blocks.zh: Section VII — Endotoxin Control | 內毒素控制
blocks.en: Section VII — Endotoxin Control

blocks.zh: VII 內毒素控制（中文解說）
blocks.en: VII Endotoxin Control (Commentary)

blocks.zh: Section VII 的核心訊息是：內毒素控制是一個系統性任務，貫穿整個製程，從原料、容器、設備到儲存時間，每一個環節都可能是內毒素引入的節點。
blocks.en: The core message of Section VII is that endotoxin control is a systematic task that runs through the entire process. From components, containers, and equipment to storage time, every step can be a point where endotoxin is introduced.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：內毒素控制的四個節點
blocks.en: Core concept: four nodes of endotoxin control

blocks.zh: 物料（Components）：每批次獨立內毒素檢驗，有接受標準。
blocks.en: Components: independent endotoxin testing of every batch, with acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: 容器與封閉件（Containers & Closures）：去熱原驗證，3-log 削減要求。
blocks.en: Containers & Closures: depyrogenation validation with the 3-log reduction requirement.

blocks.zh: 時間限制（Storage Time Limits）：存放時間愈長，微生物繁殖愈多，產生的內毒素也愈多；時間限制由數據支撐。
blocks.en: Storage time limits: the longer the hold time, the more microorganisms multiply and the more endotoxin they produce; time limits must be supported by data.

blocks.zh: 設備（Equipment）：清洗（CIP）、乾燥、儲存條件決定設備表面的內毒素水準；上下游設備都要管控。
blocks.en: Equipment: cleaning (CIP), drying, and storage conditions determine the endotoxin level on equipment surfaces; both upstream and downstream equipment must be controlled.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：設備上的內毒素 = 廚具上的細菌毒素
blocks.en: Real-life analogy: endotoxin on equipment is like bacterial toxins on kitchenware

blocks.zh: 想像一個砧板，每次用完若不徹底清洗、乾燥，殘留的食物碎屑和水分就會讓細菌大量繁殖，細菌死後留下的毒素仍然殘留在砧板上——即使你之後把砧板放進沸水裡煮，這些毒素也不一定會被破壞。製藥設備的內毒素管控邏輯完全相同：清洗 + 乾燥 + 適當儲存，才能從根本上控制內毒素的累積。
blocks.en: Imagine a cutting board. If it is not thoroughly cleaned and dried after each use, leftover food debris and moisture let bacteria multiply heavily, and the toxins left behind when the bacteria die remain on the board. Even if you later boil the board, those toxins are not necessarily destroyed. The logic of endotoxin control for pharmaceutical equipment is exactly the same: cleaning + drying + appropriate storage is what fundamentally controls endotoxin accumulation.

blocks.zh: 關鍵警告：高壓蒸汽滅菌（Autoclave）無法去除內毒素
blocks.en: Key warning: autoclaving cannot remove endotoxin

blocks.zh: FDA 明確聲明：滅菌級過濾器和濕熱滅菌（高壓蒸汽）均無法有效去除內毒素。這是許多人的常見誤解。
blocks.en: FDA states explicitly that neither sterilizing-grade filters nor moist heat sterilization (autoclaving) effectively removes endotoxin. This is a common misconception.

blocks.zh: 高壓蒸汽（121°C, 15 min）殺死細菌 — 但內毒素（LPS）耐熱，在此條件下不被破壞。
blocks.en: Autoclaving (121°C, 15 min) kills bacteria, but endotoxin (LPS) is heat resistant and is not destroyed under these conditions.

blocks.zh: 去除內毒素的方法：乾熱（180°C 以上高溫，用於玻璃器具）或化學清洗（酸、鹼、介面活性劑加 WFI 沖洗）。
blocks.en: Methods that remove endotoxin: dry heat (above 180°C, used for glassware) or chemical cleaning (acid, alkali, or surfactant followed by a WFI rinse).

blocks.zh: 對設備而言，CIP 程序（鹼洗 + WFI 終沖洗）是主要的去熱原手段。
blocks.en: For equipment, the CIP procedure (alkaline wash + final WFI rinse) is the primary means of depyrogenation.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的客戶審計中，若廠方宣稱「設備高壓滅菌後即無熱原」，將是嚴重的技術錯誤，直接質疑廠方的技術能力。
blocks.en: In a CDMO's client audit, a claim that "equipment is pyrogen-free after autoclaving" would be a serious technical error and directly calls the site's technical competence into question.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 — 內毒素控制
blocks.en: Thought Exercise — Endotoxin Control

blocks.zh: 為什麼「殺死細菌」並不等於「去除內毒素」？請從內毒素的化學本質（LPS 結構）解釋。
blocks.en: Why is "killing bacteria" not the same as "removing endotoxin"? Explain from the chemical nature of endotoxin (the LPS structure).

blocks.zh: 某設備在 CIP 後未充分乾燥，直接封存儲存了 3 天。請分析這可能帶來的內毒素風險。
blocks.en: A piece of equipment was not adequately dried after CIP and was sealed and stored for 3 days. Analyze the endotoxin risk this may create.

blocks.zh: 製程中上游設備（如配製槽）和下游設備（如充填針頭）對內毒素的貢獻方式有何不同？
blocks.en: How do upstream equipment (such as a compounding tank) and downstream equipment (such as filling needles) differ in how they contribute to endotoxin?

blocks.zh: 若某公司宣稱「設備經 121°C 高壓蒸汽滅菌，因此無熱原」，這個說法有什麼問題？
blocks.en: A company claims that "the equipment is pyrogen-free because it was autoclaved at 121°C." What is wrong with this statement?

blocks.zh: Section VIII — Time Limitations | 時間限制
blocks.en: Section VIII — Time Limitations

blocks.zh: VIII 時間限制（中文解說）
blocks.en: VIII Time Limitations (Commentary)

blocks.zh: 時間限制的核心邏輯：微生物在任何未受控的潮濕環境中都會繁殖，而繁殖不僅增加生物負荷，還會產生更多內毒素。FDA 要求每一個製程階段都必須有數據支撐的時間上限，超過該時限的任何偏差都必須有文件記錄與科學合理性說明。
blocks.en: The core logic of time limits: microorganisms multiply in any uncontrolled moist environment, and multiplication not only increases bioburden but also produces more endotoxin. FDA requires a data-supported time limit for every process stage, and any deviation beyond that limit must be documented with a scientific justification.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：需要建立時間限制的六個製程節點
blocks.en: Core concept: six process points where time limits must be established

blocks.zh: 配製開始 → 滅菌完成：此段時間愈長，生物負荷與內毒素累積愈多。
blocks.en: Start of compounding → completion of sterilization: the longer this period, the more bioburden and endotoxin accumulate.

blocks.zh: 過濾時間：時間過長，微生物可能穿透過濾膜（Filter Integrity Risk）。
blocks.en: Filtration time: if too long, microorganisms may penetrate the filter membrane (filter integrity risk).

blocks.zh: 充填線上的產品曝露時間：充填線暴露於環境中的累積時間須有上限。
blocks.en: Product exposure time on the filling line: the cumulative time the filling line is exposed to the environment must have a limit.

blocks.zh: 滅菌後設備的儲存時間：設備滅菌後存放過久，可能因環境因素重新污染。
blocks.en: Storage time of equipment after sterilization: equipment held too long after sterilization may be recontaminated by environmental factors.

blocks.zh: 滅菌後容器封閉件的儲存時間：同上，需有書面時間限制。
blocks.en: Storage time of containers and closures after sterilization: as above, a written time limit is needed.

blocks.zh: 上游澄清/去粒子過濾器的使用時間：並非只有最終滅菌過濾器需要時間限制。
blocks.en: Use time of upstream clarifying/particulate-removal filters: it is not only the final sterilizing filter that needs a time limit.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：時間限制 = 食材保存期限與食品安全時間限制
blocks.en: Real-life analogy: time limits are like shelf life and food safety time limits for ingredients

blocks.zh: 生鮮雞肉放在 4°C 冰箱裡可以存放 2 天，放在室溫下只能存放 2 小時——這不是隨意規定的，而是根據細菌繁殖速率（倍增時間）計算出的安全時間上限。超過這個時間，食物不一定有明顯異味，但細菌數量已超過安全標準。藥品製程中的時間限制邏輯完全相同：每個「保存期限」都必須有微生物生長數據支撐，而不是憑經驗拍腦袋決定。
blocks.en: Fresh chicken can be kept for 2 days in a 4°C refrigerator but only 2 hours at room temperature. This is not an arbitrary rule; it is a safe upper time limit calculated from the bacterial growth rate (doubling time). Past that time, the food may not smell off, yet the bacterial count has already exceeded the safety standard. The logic of time limits in drug manufacturing is exactly the same: every "hold time" must be supported by microbial growth data rather than decided by guesswork based on experience.

blocks.zh: CDMO 稽查重點：時間限制的文件管理
blocks.en: CDMO audit focus: documentation of time limits

blocks.zh: FDA 及客戶稽查時，時間限制相關的常見缺失包括：
blocks.en: Common deficiencies related to time limits during FDA and client audits include:

blocks.zh: 批次記錄（Batch Record）中未記錄各階段的實際開始/結束時間
blocks.en: The batch record does not record the actual start/end times of each stage

blocks.zh: 時間限制無數據支撐，僅為歷史慣例（"We've always done it this way"）
blocks.en: Time limits have no data support and are merely historical practice ("We've always done it this way")

blocks.zh: 超時偏差（Time Limit Deviation）未依 21 CFR 211.111 進行文件化說明
blocks.en: Time limit deviations are not documented under 21 CFR 211.111

blocks.zh: 過濾時間限制只針對最終滅菌過濾器，而忽略了上游澄清過濾器
blocks.en: Filtration time limits apply only to the final sterilizing filter and ignore the upstream clarifying filter

blocks.zh: 滅菌後容器/設備的儲存時間未在 SOP 中明確規定
blocks.en: Storage time limits for containers/equipment after sterilization are not clearly defined in the SOP

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，時間限制的科學依據（驗證研究報告）必須隨時可供稽查人員查閱。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the scientific basis for time limits (validation study reports) must be available to auditors at all times.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 — 時間限制
blocks.en: Thought Exercise — Time Limits

blocks.zh: 某批次在配製完成後，因設備故障延遲了 2 小時才開始過濾滅菌，超出了 SOP 規定的時間限制。公司應如何處理這個偏差？依 21 CFR 211.111，什麼條件下偏差可以被接受？
blocks.en: After compounding of a batch was completed, an equipment failure delayed the start of sterilizing filtration by 2 hours, exceeding the time limit in the SOP. How should the company handle this deviation? Under 21 CFR 211.111, under what conditions can a deviation be accepted?

blocks.zh: 為什麼過濾時間過長會帶來雙重風險（過濾膜完整性 + 生物負荷/內毒素）？這兩個風險各自如何影響最終產品品質？
blocks.en: Why does an overly long filtration time create a double risk (filter membrane integrity plus bioburden/endotoxin)? How does each risk affect final product quality?

blocks.zh: 某公司只對最終滅菌過濾器設定了使用時間限制，但對上游澄清過濾器沒有規定。FDA 會如何看待這個做法？
blocks.en: A company has set a use time limit only for the final sterilizing filter and none for the upstream clarifying filter. How would FDA view this practice?

blocks.zh: 建立「配製 → 滅菌」時間限制時，需要收集哪些數據？請描述一個合理的驗證研究設計。
blocks.en: When establishing the "compounding → sterilization" time limit, what data need to be collected? Describe a reasonable validation study design.

blocks.zh: CFR Citations Summary | 法規引用摘要
blocks.en: CFR Citations Summary

blocks.zh: CDMO Audit Readiness Summary | CDMO 稽查整備重點摘要
blocks.en: CDMO Audit Readiness Summary

blocks.zh: CDMO 稽查整備重點（中文摘要）
blocks.en: CDMO Audit Readiness Highlights (Summary)

blocks.zh: 以下是本節內容對 CDMO 業務最直接的合規影響，也是客戶稽查和 FDA 查廠時最常被聚焦的領域。
blocks.en: The following are the compliance implications of this section most directly relevant to CDMO business, and the areas most often targeted in client audits and FDA inspections.

blocks.zh: 人員（Section V）：合規狀態快速評估
blocks.en: Personnel (Section V): quick compliance self-assessment

blocks.zh: 所有無菌區操作員是否有完整的初始訓練記錄，涵蓋七大主題？
blocks.en: Do all aseptic area operators have complete initial training records covering the seven topics?

blocks.zh: 著裝資格鑑定是否按 SOP 執行，包含四個取樣部位？
blocks.en: Is gowning qualification performed according to the SOP, including the four sampling sites?

blocks.zh: 超標後是否有調查、再訓練、再鑑定的閉環記錄？
blocks.en: Is there a closed-loop record of investigation, retraining, and requalification after an excursion?

blocks.zh: 人員監測是否每天/每批執行，並有趨勢分析？
blocks.en: Is personnel monitoring performed every day/every batch, with trend analysis?

blocks.zh: 物料與容器（Section VI）：合規狀態快速評估
blocks.en: Materials and containers (Section VI): quick compliance self-assessment

blocks.zh: 每批原料是否有內毒素 + 生物負荷測試記錄，且有明確接受標準？
blocks.en: Does every batch of components have endotoxin and bioburden test records with clear acceptance criteria?

blocks.zh: 玻璃容器去熱原驗證是否證明達到 3-log（1000 倍）削減？
blocks.en: Does the glass container depyrogenation validation demonstrate a 3-log (1000-fold) reduction?

blocks.zh: 委外滅菌廠的驗證報告是否經過 QA 審查並有書面記錄？
blocks.en: Have the validation reports of outsourced sterilization contractors been reviewed by QA and the review documented?

blocks.zh: CCI 驗證是否使用了非視覺方式的靈敏測試方法？
blocks.en: Does CCI validation use sensitive, non-visual test methods?

blocks.zh: 內毒素控制（Section VII）：合規狀態快速評估
blocks.en: Endotoxin control (Section VII): quick compliance self-assessment

blocks.zh: CIP 程序 SOP 是否明確規定各步驟的水質要求、清洗劑類型、終沖洗條件？
blocks.en: Does the CIP SOP clearly specify, for each step, the water quality requirements, cleaning agent type, and final rinse conditions?

blocks.zh: 廠方是否清楚理解高壓蒸汽不能去熱原，並在文件中正確表述？
blocks.en: Does the site clearly understand that autoclaving does not depyrogenate, and is this correctly stated in documents?

blocks.zh: 設備清洗後乾燥的 SOP 是否存在且被遵循？
blocks.en: Does an SOP for drying equipment after cleaning exist, and is it followed?

blocks.zh: 時間限制（Section VIII）：合規狀態快速評估
blocks.en: Time limits (Section VIII): quick compliance self-assessment

blocks.zh: 批次記錄是否記錄了所有製程階段的實際開始/結束時間？
blocks.en: Does the batch record capture the actual start/end times of all process stages?

blocks.zh: 每個時間限制是否有驗證數據支撐（非僅憑慣例）？
blocks.en: Is every time limit supported by validation data (not just habit)?

blocks.zh: 時間偏差是否按 21 CFR 211.111 進行了文件化及合理性說明？
blocks.en: Are time deviations documented and justified in accordance with 21 CFR 211.111?

blocks.zh: 上游澄清過濾器是否也有時間限制規定？
blocks.en: Is there also a time limit for the upstream clarifying filter?

blocks.zh: 一句話記住本節的核心邏輯
blocks.en: The core logic of this section in one sentence

blocks.zh: 人員（People）+ 物料（Materials）+ 清潔（Cleaning）+ 時間（Time）= 內毒素控制的四根支柱。任何一根柱子不穩，最終產品的內毒素合規就面臨風險，而這個風險的代價是：批次拒絕、客戶通知、市場召回、FDA 483 觀察項目。
blocks.en: People + Materials + Cleaning + Time = the four pillars of endotoxin control. If any one pillar is unstable, the endotoxin compliance of the final product is at risk, and the cost of that risk is batch rejection, customer notification, market recall, and FDA Form 483 observations.
